name: ScoutRAG API-Football Bundesliga 2025/2026 retrieval seed
labeling_method: Rule-assisted manual seed: exact and team labels use typed metadata; trait labels rank real players by the exact structured feature the query's trait maps to (scoutrag.retrieval.query_analysis.TRAIT_METRICS), reviewed against the generated profiles. Traits unavailable in API-Football's feature set (pressing, progressive passing/carrying, expected assists) are deliberately not used here; see governance_cases.json for how the system handles a request for one of them.
limitations: This is a small portfolio seed, not an independent multi-annotator relevance study.

position_group percentiles are computed per competition, so unscoped queries across all 24 leagues can produce many tied top scores; every trait query here is scoped to a team or to the Bundesliga to keep the comparison group well-defined.

Refined position groups (center_back, fullback_wingback, defensive_midfield, central_midfield, attacking_midfield, winger) come from scoutrag.data.position_inference and are only assigned when a clear majority of a player's starts agree; players without that agreement remain at their coarse provider group and are absent from position-scoped queries here even if plausible candidates.

queries.query: Zeige das Profil von Joshua Kimmich

judgments.rationale: Exact player identity match; Kimmich is Bayern Munich's starting defensive midfielder in 2025/2026.

notes: Verified live against the combined dataset: exact/sparse/dense all agree on this candidate.

queries.query: Show the profile of Manuel Neuer

judgments.rationale: Exact player identity match; Neuer is Bayern Munich's starting goalkeeper with 1,860 minutes in 2025/2026.
Luis Díaz, refined position winger, 2,450 minutes for Bayern Munich 2025/2026.
Michael Olise, refined position winger, 2,317 minutes for Bayern Munich 2025/2026.

notes: Bayern's squad has exactly two profiles refined to winger this season; both are established starters.

queries.query: Innenverteidiger von Bayern München mit mindestens 150 Minuten

judgments.rationale: Jonathan Tah, refined position center_back, 2,024 minutes.
Dayotchanculle Upamecano, refined position center_back, 1,797 minutes.
Kim Min-Jae, refined position center_back, 1,621 minutes.

notes: Verified live: this exact query returns exactly these three candidates.

queries.query: Innenverteidiger mit vielen Ballgewinnen in der Bundesliga mit mindestens 900 Minuten

judgments.rationale: Upamecano leads Bundesliga center_backs at >=900 minutes on tackles_per_90 (2.20, percentile 100).
Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) ranks second on tackles_per_90 (2.18, percentile 97.1).
Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) ranks third on tackles_per_90 (2.14, percentile 94.1).

notes: ball_winning maps to tackles_per_90, interceptions_per_90, and ball_recoveries_per_90; ball_recoveries_per_90 is unavailable in API-Football data, so tackles_per_90 dominates the ranking used here.

queries.query: Dribbelstarker Zehner in der Bundesliga mit mindestens 900 Minuten

judgments.rationale: Nikolas Nartey (Stuttgart) leads Bundesliga attacking_midfield at >=900 minutes on dribbles_completed_per_90 (percentile 75.0).
Can Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) ranks second on dribbles_completed_per_90 (percentile 62.5).
Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) ranks third on dribbles_completed_per_90 (percentile 50.0).

queries.query: Torgefährlicher Stürmer in der Bundesliga mit mindestens 900 Minuten

judgments.rationale: Deniz Undav (Stuttgart) leads Bundesliga forwards at >=900 minutes on shots_per_90 (3.60, percentile 100).
Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) ranks second on shots_per_90 (3.44, percentile 98.8).
Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) ranks third on shots_per_90 (2.94, percentile 97.6).

notes: shooting maps to shots_per_90 and expected_goals_per_90; expected_goals_per_90 is unavailable in API-Football data, so this is a shot-volume ranking, not an xG-quality ranking.

queries.query: Holding midfielder with strong ball recoveries in the Bundesliga with at least 900 minutes

judgments.rationale: Vinicius Souza (Wolfsburg) leads Bundesliga defensive_midfield at >=900 minutes on tackles_per_90 (2.78, percentile 100).
Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) ranks second on tackles_per_90 (2.06, percentile 86.7).

notes: Mirrors bundesliga-cb-ball-winning-de in English to test the same trait/position mapping across both supported query languages.
